description: Berliner Wasserbetriebe - Wasseranalysedaten der Wasserwerke is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Berlin Open Data. Dargestellt sind die Jahresmedianwerte für 2016 der Analysedaten für das Trinkwasser aus den 9 Wasserwerken der Berliner Wasserbetriebe. Trinkwasser ist in Deutschland das am besten kontrollierte Lebensmittel. Damit Wasser als Trinkwasser bezeichnet und als Lebensmittel verwendet werden darf, muss es der deutschen Trinkwasserverordnung (TrinkwV) entsprechen. Coverage: Berlin Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher Berlin Open Data. Its tags are analysedaten, berliner-wasserbetriebe, spurenstoffe, trinkwasser, wasserversorgung. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
